name: progress
title: Progress
description: Displays an indicator showing the completion progress of a task, typically displayed as a progress bar.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value of the progress bar when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the progress bar.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: The options to use for formatting the value.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the progress bar. Useful for composition.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale to use for formatting the value.

props.name: max
props.description: The maximum allowed value of the progress bar.

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum allowed value of the progress bar.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the progress bar.

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Callback fired when the value changes.

accessibilityNotes: The root exposes `role="progressbar"` with `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, and `aria-valuemax` (or `aria-valuetext` for indeterminate progress) via Zag's `getRootProps()` — no manual ARIA wiring needed.
Progress is a passive status indicator with no keyboard interaction of its own — nothing needs `accessibilityKeyboard` here.
When `label` is set, the caption and value text are linked to the root through `getLabelProps()`/`getValueTextProps()`, so assistive tech announces both together.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A progress bar filled to a fixed `value` out of the default 0-100 range.

examples.title: With label
examples.source:
import Progress from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/progress/progress.marko";

<Progress value=40 label="Uploading..." class="w-64"/>
examples.description: Pass `label` to render a caption and live value text above the track.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import Progress from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/progress/progress.marko";
value: ${value}
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `value` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `valueChange`, or use Marko's bind shorthand `value:=state`.

examples.title: RTL
examples.source: import Progress from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/progress/progress.marko";
examples.description: To enable RTL support, set `dir="rtl"` on an ancestor. Our indicator fills via Zag's `getRangeProps()`, not a manual transform, so no extra RTL class is needed.

examples.title: Min / Max
examples.source:
import Progress from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/progress/progress.marko";

<Progress value=150 min=0 max=200 label="Storage used" class="w-64"/>
examples.description: Set a custom `min` and `max` when the value isn't a 0-100 percentage.

examples.title: Indeterminate
examples.source:
import Progress from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/progress/progress.marko";

<Progress value=null label="Loading..." class="w-64"/>
examples.description: Pass `value=null` when progress can't be measured yet.

composition:
`Progress` renders its full anatomy — an optional label row and a
track/indicator pair — from one tag. Pass `label` to render the caption
and live value text above the track; without it, only the track renders.

```text
Progress
├── (label row, when `label` is set)
│   ├── label
│   └── value text
└── track
    └── indicator
```
